# formalized as

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](gmeow-formalizedAs.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/formalizedAs>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Attaches a machine formalization to a condition. NOT functional: one condition, several formalizations (one per engine), each a separate equivalence claim with its own confidence and vantage through the statement layer.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) -> [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](gmeow-formalizedAs.md) from [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) to [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md), [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a machine formalization to a condition — each attachment a claim that the expression captures the canonical prose.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing one formalization (it is non-functional — one condition may carry one expression per engine) and avoid treating the attachment as proven equivalence; it is a challengeable claim.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](gmeow-formalizedAs.md) from a [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) to each [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md); carry the equivalence claim's confidence and vantage on the statement layer.
